# ChartAnnotationLayer

`Flare.Components.ChartAnnotationLayer`

Which side of the data an annotation is drawn on.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Over` | `0` | Over the series, above lines, bars and markers (the default). |
| `Under` | `1` | Under the series, over the plot background and the grid. What a shaded period marker wants: a translucent band over the data washes out the values it is meant to frame, while the same band behind them reads as the background of the period. |
